attachments.content:
Mirenta Pflegepersonal
Rate card – from 1st of this month

Registered nurse: on request
Care assistant: on request

One hourly rate for every shift, nights and weekends included.
Minimum booking 6 hours. Cancellation free of charge up to 24 hours before the shift; later cancellations are charged in full.
Lead time: as stated in the booking portal for each offer.

mails.body:
Hi all,

The next works council (Betriebsrat) is on Wed 21 Jan 2026 at 2pm in the training room. On the agenda: rotas for the coming weeks, overtime and training. Please send me any points beforehand.

Thanks
Stefan Schmitt
mails.subject: Works council (Betriebsrat) – date for your diary

mails.body:
Dear Ahmet,

Please find attached the hours we processed for December 2025. For the next run we need any changes to contracted hours, new starters and leavers by Fri 16 Jan 2026. Hours above or below contract go to each person's hours account and are balanced with time off; overtime is paid out only when the home manager approves it.

If any of the figures look wrong, reply to this mail with the staff number and the corrected hours – please do not edit the file.

Kind regards
Julia Braun
Lohnbüro Sorantis
mails.subject: Payroll cut-off for December and next run
